task.question: What date was Progress MS-33 launched to the ISS?
task.evidence: On 22 March, Roscosmos launched Progress MS-33 to ISS, the first space station uncrewed cargo flight of the year and the first launch from the Baikonur Cosmodrome Site 31 after substantial repairs necessitated by the damage caused by the November 2025 launch of Soyuz MS-28. Further resupply missions to ISS were: Cygnus NG-24 on 11 April, Progress MS-34 on 25 April, and SpaceX CRS-34 on 15 May.

answer: FINAL: Progress MS-33 was launched to the ISS on March 22, 2026.

What date was Progress MS-33 launched to the ISS?

[Progress MS-33] Progress MS-33 (Russian: Прогресс МC-33), Russian production No. 463, identified by NASA as Progress 94, was a Progress cargo spacecraft mission by Roscosmos to resupply the International Space Station (ISS). It is the 186th flight of a Progress spacecraft and was originally scheduled to launch in late 2025, but was delayed to 22 March 2026 due to damage at Baikonur Cosmodrome Site 31 following the launch of Soyuz MS-28. | other articles: Progress MS, Progress MS-35
FINAL: Progress MS-33 was launched to the ISS on March 22, 2026.
